name: John Buford
desc: Buford's cavalry fought a delaying action west of Gettysburg on the morning of July 1, buying time for Union infantry to occupy favorable terrain.

name: John Reynolds
desc: Reynolds arrived to support Buford and was killed while directing Union troops near McPherson Ridge.

name: Oliver O. Howard
desc: Howard helped establish the Union defensive position centered on Cemetery Hill after the first day's retreat through Gettysburg.

name: Abner Doubleday
desc: Doubleday assumed command of the Union I Corps after Reynolds was killed.

name: Henry Heth
desc: Heth's Confederate division initiated the fighting west of Gettysburg on July 1.

name: Richard S. Ewell
desc: Ewell's corps arrived from the north and participated in successful attacks that drove Union forces through Gettysburg.
